+/// Golden output embeds absolute paths, and the *length* of the raw path

+/// provider's prompt-length-derived token counts. Build every test workspace
+/// at one fixed canonical path length on every platform (`/tmp` is
+/// `/private/tmp` on macOS, `/tmp` on Linux — pad to a shared prefix) so the
+/// goldens are byte-stable across operating systems.
+fn fixed_length_tempdir() -> TempDir {
+    let base = Path::new("/tmp").canonicalize().expect("canonical /tmp");
+    const PREFIX_LEN: usize = 24;

+        .expect("/tmp canonical prefix too long for the fixed-length test root");
+    let root = base.join("d".repeat(pad_len.max(1)));
+    fs::create_dir_all(&root).expect("padded test root");
+    tempfile::Builder::new()
+        .prefix("c")
+        .tempdir_in(root)
+        .expect("tempdir")
+}

298	fn normalized_capture(temp: &TempDir, output: &Output) -> String {

307	fn normalize_text(temp: &TempDir, text: &str) -> String {
308	    let mut normalized = text.to_string();
309	    for path in temp_path_variants(temp.path()) {
310	        normalized = normalized.replace(&path, "<TMP>");
311	    }
312	    for (pattern, replacement) in [
313	        (r"([0-9a-f]{8,})(\.\.\.)", "<HEX>$2"),
314	        (r"\b[0-9a-f]{32}\b", "<ID32>"),
315	        (r"\b[0-9a-f]{12,40}\b", "<HEX>"),
316	        (r"\b[0-9a-f]{8}\b", "<ID8>"),
317	        (r"\b[0-9a-f]{7}\b", "<SHA7>"),
318	        (
319	            r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}\.\d+ UTC",
320	            "<TIMESTAMP>",
321	        ),
322	        (r"wall [0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?s", "wall <DURATION>"),
323	        (
324	            r"attach-characterize-[0-9a-f]{4}",
325	            "attach-characterize-<SLUG>",
326	        ),
327	    ] {
328	        normalized = Regex::new(pattern)
329	            .expect("BUG: characterization regex must compile")
330	            .replace_all(&normalized, replacement)
331	            .into_owned();
332	    }
333	    normalized
334	}
335	
336	fn temp_path_variants(path: &Path) -> Vec<String> {
337	    let mut variants = vec![path.display().to_string()];
338	    if let Ok(canonical) = path.canonicalize() {
339	        variants.push(canonical.display().to_string());
340	    }
341	    let mut private_variants = Vec::new();
342	    for variant in &variants {
343	        if let Some(stripped) = variant.strip_prefix("/private") {
344	            private_variants.push(stripped.to_string());
345	        } else if variant.starts_with("/var/") || variant.starts_with("/tmp/") {
346	            private_variants.push(format!("/private{variant}"));
347	        }
348	    }
349	    variants.extend(private_variants);
350	    variants.sort_by_key(|variant| std::cmp::Reverse(variant.len()));
351	    variants.dedup();
352	    variants
353	}
354	
355	fn started_run_prefix(stdout: &str) -> String {
356	    stdout
357	        .lines()
358	        .find_map(|line| line.strip_prefix("started run "))
359	        .and_then(|rest| rest.split_whitespace().next())
360	        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("missing started run line:\n{stdout}"))
361	        .to_string()
362	}

_**Agent (claude-opus-4-7 2026-06-09 21:35:35Z)**_

This change is entirely within a test file (`crates/deadreckon/tests/characterization.rs`). The three modifications are:

1. A new `fixed_length_tempdir()` helper that creates a predictable, shared directory under `/tmp` (e.g. `/tmp/dddddddd...`) for path-length stability in golden tests
2. Switching test `TempDir::new()` calls to that helper
3. An env-var-gated golden update mode (`DEADRECKON_UPDATE_GOLDENS`) that overwrites in-repo golden fixture files with current test output

Per the review method, test/mock files are excluded from reporting. The only theoretically interesting issue — a predictable, world-writable parent dir under `/tmp` that an attacker on a shared host could pre-create as a symlink to redirect the random `tempdir_in` subdir — is a test-infrastructure concern only (no production code path), and the inner directory is still random via `tempfile::Builder`. The `DEADRECKON_UPDATE_GOLDENS` write path only triggers when an env var is set by the test runner and writes a fixed `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/tests/goldens/characterization/<name>` path with no attacker-influenced filename component (name is a hard-coded string literal at every call site).

No production-impact security findings.
